entity_relationship_policy: Only declared entity-typed fields. Scalar *Id fields are retained as scalar attributes; no guessed foreign keys.
usecase_policy: One Spring @Service class is one use-case proxy; all its public non-static methods are operations. Existing module boundary is not a clustering constraint. Module roles are actor proxies.
method_graph_policy: Declared receiver types, this.field selectors, interface-to-implementation expansion, method name/arity; Feign app name/HTTP method/path to Controller route; Mapper XML/result types and monotonic entity reachability. No reflection/runtime dispatch/library implementation modeling.
